patronOf.en-US: Bread and wine become Christ's Body and Blood
patronOf.pt-BR: O pão e o vinho tornam-se o Corpo e o Sangue de Cristo

prayerExcerpt.en-US: Take this, all of you, and eat of it, for this is my body, which will be given up for you.
prayerExcerpt.pt-BR: Tomai, todos, e comei: Isto é o meu Corpo, que será entregue por vós.

meta.basis: After the words over the bread the priest 'shows the consecrated host to the people, places it again on the paten, and genuflects in adoration' (the Order of Mass rubric, Eucharistic Prayer II; GIRM 79d); a minister rings the small bell at each elevation according to local custom, and if incense is used a minister incenses the host when it is shown (GIRM 150). The faithful kneel (GIRM 43, USCCB). Composed as the x_consecration test draft (2026-09-29), without its server lifting the chasuble's hem, which the rubrics don't give.
